links.outcome: Flesch Reading Ease of ChatGPT-4 responses on physical activity in children with cystic fibrosis
links.effect: Readability mean scores varied from 29.99 (S5) to 46.31 (S3), with a total mean of 38.07; most responses were 'difficult' for the target age group.
links.quote: Low FRE scores showed most responses were "difficult" for the target age group.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT-4's accuracy, quality, and readability on physical activity queries for cystic fibrosis without testing a specific organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
